blocks.text: The Granary at Southlands (garden flats component) — Red Barn Boulevard and Market Avenue, Southlands

A presale record describes The Granary by Century Group as a 3-storey woodframe development offering 16 garden flats (single-level, 1-bedroom, four floorplans) alongside 19 townhomes, with a central garden courtyard, underground parkade with elevator access, and the Four Winds brewery and gastropub enclosing the north end of the courtyard; Centennial Beach is stated as 1.4 km away. Completion timing on the record read: TBA — treat any unit here as a presale/developer-sale question (GST and REDMA) until its status is confirmed per unit.
District Flats at Southlands — Southlands, Market Avenue area

A development-industry report records District Flats among Southlands' sold-out phases, with 34 one- and two-bedroom homes; the same report describes Southlands housing as including condos (referred to as "flats" by Century Group), townhomes, cottages and row homes across a planned 950 homes.
Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: Feed streets include Centennial Parkway, 66 Street, 3 Avenue, and Market Avenue / Southlands Drive in the Southlands.

Municipality and plan: Tsawwassen, City of Delta, under the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, "Housing Our Future", Bylaw No. 8400, adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan with no separate Tsawwassen area plan.

The ground itself: Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach, 570 Boundary Bay Rd (Metro Vancouver) — Dyke Trail, Savannah and Raptor trails, Cammidge House; Metro Vancouver identifies the park as an internationally recognized Important Bird Area and a critical rest stop on the Pacific Flyway, and notes most of Centennial Beach is closed to dogs, with signed marker posts showing where dogs are prohibited.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: inside Southlands, the Century Group master-planned community at Market Avenue (sales centre 101 – 6388 Market Avenue) — its flats and townhomes are the sub-area's known strata product.

Transit: TransLink route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line).

Health care: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, in Ladner, is the nearest hospital, and Fraser Health lists a South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre serving Tsawwassen at 1826 – 4949 Canoe Pass Way.

The hazard permit area is named for this area. SD3 is literally titled "Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands" in OCP Appendix B — the 2.9 m / 2.3 m / 7.5 m figures are not generic Delta rules applied here; they were written for this shoreline and this development area.

"Flats" is the developer's word for condos at Southlands. Century Group calls its apartment product "flats" (garden flats, country flats) — a buyer searching only "condos" misses District Flats, High Street Flats and The Granary's flat component in developer and presale records.

The Granary's courtyard neighbour is a brewery. The Four Winds brewery and gastropub encloses the north end of The Granary's garden courtyard — an amenity and a noise/activity fact in the same structure, worth a site visit at pub hours before writing on a courtyard-facing flat.

Most of Centennial Beach is closed to dogs. Metro Vancouver states most of the beach is dog-prohibited, with signed marker posts showing where — a daily-life fact for dog owners that listing copy for "steps to the beach" homes does not mention.

Where the townhomes are and what to know

items.t: Market statistics: none. SnapStats in any case reports attached product only as Detached versus "Condos & Townhomes" combined, never a townhome-only figure.
Where the townhouse stock actually sits: not on the beachfront.

Services and health: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd in Ladner, is the nearest hospital; Fraser Health lists a South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 1826 – 4949 Canoe Pass Way.

Form B diligence (Monterra is strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

The dike trail is a working dike. Boundary Bay Regional Park's Dyke Trail runs on the dike system Delta maintains as flood protection (over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure city-wide) — recreation on top of infrastructure, which is why foreshore work is permitted, not casual.

Most of Centennial Beach is closed to dogs. Metro Vancouver notes signed marker posts show where dogs are prohibited in the park — a daily-life fact for a rancher-community buyer steps from the beach.

The old area-plan name is gone from the current OCP: Bylaw No. 8400 (2024) consolidated the former area plans, including the Tsawwassen Area Plan, into a single Land Use Plan. City reports that predate July 2024 may still use the earlier name.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Boundary Beach

items.t: Fee-simple is the default tenure here: no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees on a fee-simple lot.
Subdivision potential runs off the parcel's own zone; zoning is parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps.

blocks.text: Bare-land strata as its own form

items.t: A bare-land strata lot is strata tenure: the buyer owns the strata lot (essentially the building lot itself) and the house on it, and Form B, strata fees for common property, and registered bylaws apply to the lot. It is not a fee-simple lot.
ALR vs non-ALR split: no area-wide split is published and none is stated. Any individual parcel's ALR status is checked on the ALC maps by PID or civic address.

For any unserviced parcel: GWELLS for wells, and Fraser Health's onsite-sewerage position (a home not connected to a community sewer needs an onsite system complying with the Sewerage System Regulation, designed and installed by an Authorized Person).

blocks.text: Where lots come up and what to know

items.t: Market statistics: none.

Bare-land strata / strata block (applies to any strata lot here, Monterra included): Form B (SPA s. 59) discloses monthly fees, amounts owed, approved levies still payable, CRF balance and insurance summary, with rules, budget and most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page. Depreciation reports every 5 years for strata corporations with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024, non-deferrable. CRF minimum contribution 10% of the operating budget since November 1, 2023. Rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022 (long-term; short-term may still be restricted) — Monterra's data-sheet "Rentals Not Allowed" line is void for long-term rentals. Only 55+ age bylaws are valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Regulation 7.01, incl. the May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is not a valid BC age bylaw, and Monterra's "Adult Oriented" site-influence line is not an age bylaw. Fee-simple contrast: a fee-simple lot carries none of this.
Monterra's form is genuinely contested in listings. For land purposes the point is simpler: either way the lot is a strata lot.

Waterfront homes here sit behind engineered seawalls on private property, not a public promenade, which is why two houses on the same street can have very different flood works.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands (SD3) Development Permit Area is the controlling rule: the City's seawall form requires a crest elevation of 4.1 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada (GSC) datum, designed so it can be raised a further 1.4 metres, with a wave deflector and erosion protection at the toe.
A new seawall needs an engineered design by a structural engineer, and an existing seawall needs an engineer's certification of its structural and flood-protection integrity.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Most of Centennial Beach is closed to dogs, with signed marker posts showing where dogs are prohibited — relevant if you are buying for daily dog walks.
The park is an internationally recognized Important Bird Area and a Pacific Flyway stop, so seasonal bird closures and crowds are part of beach life here.
Route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street, so the beach streets do have a bus, but it is the long way to Bridgeport Station.
The Dyke Trail runs through Boundary Bay Regional Park, so the dike top doubles as the neighbourhood's walking and cycling route, not just flood works.
Driving is the default here: Boundary Bay Road and 56 Street are the routes north to Highway 17 and the George Massey Tunnel corridor.
The British Columbia Ferries (BC Ferries) Tsawwassen terminal is reached by Highway 17, with sailings to Swartz Bay, Duke Point and the Southern Gulf Islands.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: risks and due diligence

items.t: Seawall condition is the lot-specific risk: get the engineer's certification the City requires for existing seawalls, and price future raising, because the design standard assumes the crest may need to go 1.4 metres higher.

Sea-level rise is the long-term driver: the City states future sea levels are expected to rise and its dike must be raised to protect the community, which is why flood covenants and floor levels follow these lots on title.

faq.a: None that I know of. The apartment-condo projects (The Granary's 16 garden flats, District Flats' 34 homes) sit inside Southlands at the Market Avenue side; the beachfront streets are detached houses, and the 3 Avenue attached stock is the gated Monterra rancher community.
faq.q: Is there a condo on the beach at Boundary Beach?

faq.a: One 3-storey woodframe Century Group project at Red Barn Boulevard and Market Avenue in Southlands, recorded on its presale record as 16 single-level garden flats plus 19 walk-up townhomes around a garden courtyard, with underground parking and the Four Winds brewery/gastropub at the courtyard's north end. Completion on that record: TBA — so GST and the REDMA 7-day rescission frame apply to a developer purchase, and per-unit status must be confirmed before relying on either.

Listings disagree — sub-type Duplex in one, Townhouse in another, for the same gated community at 6505 3 Avenue (built 1992/1993 across the listings read). It is attached strata product either way and is not an apartment condo; the strata plan and Form B settle the form for a specific lot.
faq.q: Is Monterra a townhouse complex or duplexes?

faq.a: Its rancher format reads as downsizer product.
Yes as a matter of provincial law — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw; read the registered bylaws.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Southlands flat or a Monterra unit long-term?

faq.a: Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw — read the registered bylaws.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Monterra home?

faq.a: Monterra is a strata community, not a 2-lot duplex: A unit there is a strata lot in plan LMS469, bought on Form B diligence like any strata lot. The "half-duplex" wording is one listing's sub-type label, not a separate title form.
faq.q: Can I buy just one half of a Monterra home?

faq.a: Hazard DPA SD3 sets a 2.9 m GSC datum minimum floor level, a 2.3 m minimum land surface elevation and a 7.5 m setback from the natural boundary of a tidal area; the shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike maintained by the City of Delta; and the foreshore itself is provincial Crown land held by lease or licence. Whether SD3 captures a specific parcel is a parcel-level check.
faq.q: What flood and foreshore rules apply to a waterfront home here?

faq.a: Delta's SSMUH updates allow up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots, with City support for coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites as accessory dwelling units. That affects the pocket's detached/duplex lots, not the strata lots inside Monterra.
faq.q: Can Delta lots here be built with more units?

faq.a: Read the parcel's own zone off the City zoning maps.
faq.q: Which Delta zoning bylaw number should I quote?

faq.a: A dike and private seawalls protect them, and both are regulated. Delta maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection, and the City's seawall form for this foreshore requires a 4.1-metre GSC crest that can later be raised 1.4 metres. Ask for the seawall's engineering certification before you buy, not after.
faq.q: What protects these houses from the sea?

faq.a: The Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore in British Columbia. Private moorage and foreshore use are by provincial permission, lease or licence through FrontCounter BC, so a dock or steps over the foreshore are a tenure question to check on title and with the Province.
faq.q: Who owns the beach in front of a waterfront house?

faq.a: South Park Elementary at 735 Gilchrist Drive is the school on the south Tsawwassen side nearest these streets, and South Delta Secondary at 750 53 Street is the area's secondary school; catchment is address-based and the district directs families to verify it.
